body: I don't know this codebase well, but as far as I can tell, `'music'` simply needs to be added [here](https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/blob/dev/packages/integrations/src/overseerr/overseerr-integration.ts#L398) so that the integration does not fail.

Yes, but have they finalised that name or will it change? If it is final, we can add it. You can contribute the change if you want to.
My goal is that we do not have to change multiple things if they decide to change it later to something else.

As far as I can tell, the code is finalized and ready to be merged. The [original PR](https://github.com/seerr-team/seerr/pull/1238) for Jellyseerr (and by extension, the `preview-music-support` tag) has been around for a year with minimal changes, but has been on the backburner as Overseerrr and Jellyseerr combine their codebase to become Seerr. There have been many people, including myself, who have been using that branch without issue and it's widely considered stable.

The original Jellyseerr PR was [rebased on the new Seerr code](https://github.com/seerr-team/seerr/pull/2132) with minimal changes, and they are planning to use it in Seerr, but it's literally at [the bottom of their TODO list](https://github.com/seerr-team/seerr/issues/926) for review/merging.

So, I can say with a lot of confidence that the current API for Lidarr support will remain the same when it's merged.

> You can contribute the change if you want to.

I would like to, but I have minimal experience with web dev, zero experience with Vite, and I have no clue how to run or debug this project, so I wouldn't be able to submit anything (even a small change like this) with confidence as I have no idea how to test my changes and ensure nothing broke.

> the code is finalized and ready to be merged

Seerr maintainer here.
This Lidarr PR is not finished, a lot of review are still to be done so we cannot guarantee that it is not going to change.
Thanks for chiming in  @gauthier-th , we will wait until it goes stable. @Giggitybyte please switch back your branch or wait until it goes stable. Thanks

No, that won't happen since Homarr can't handle the new value after just loosening the validation. Please wait until it goes stable.

Our policy clearly states that we do not support alpha or beta releases, this is no exception.
